bear.point: EBITDA margin fell 2.1 pp YoY to 24.7%, indicating deteriorating operating leverage.
Capex of INR 5,300 crores in Q1 FY27 is partial against the INR 25,000 crores annual target.
Tata Projects losses widened in the quarter, dragging down consolidated profitability.
Curtailment losses remain unquantified, creating uncertainty over renewable energy revenue realization.

bull.point: PAT grew 32.7% YoY, outpacing 26.3% revenue growth to show operating leverage.
Debt/equity improved to 1.93 from 2.28, reducing financial risk and interest burden.
Operating cash flow was 2.24× PAT, ensuring high cash conversion and debt repayment capacity.
Rooftop revenue is targeted to grow 60% to 70% this year, diversifying income streams.
